The value to put in 'Category id' on the FAQ form.
답변을 입력하고 저장하면 상태가 '답변완료'로 바뀌고 작성자에게 메일이: Saving a reply sets the status to 'Answered' and emails the author. If the author writes again, it returns to 'Open'.
Copy the id from the category list. Empty = no category.
저장하면 대화에 추가되고 작성자에게 알립니다. 비워두면 답변하지 않습니다: Saving appends it to the conversation and notifies the author. Leave empty to not reply.
조회수와 '도움이 되었나'를 보고 답변을 개선하세요. 많이 읽히고 도움이: Use view counts and 'Was this helpful' to improve answers. Widely-read entries that didn't help are the ones to fix.
